body:
> Profile · Summit Az · 2026-10-01

# Summary
The single source of truth for anyone writing or optimizing for Summit Plumbing Pros Arizona (summitplumbingpros.com). Compiled Oct 1, 2026 from project memory, CLAUDE.md, the Company Avatar doc, Scott's confirmations and 114 past sessions. Every field is labeled Verified, On site (not owner-verified) or Unknown. Binding rules in [Summit AZ - Project Guide (CLAUDE.md)](lib:brain-summit-az-project-guide-claude-md) and [Summit AZ - OTTO Business Rules 2026-09-05](lib:brain-summit-az-otto-business-rules-2026-09-05) win over this profile. Arizona only; the Utah company (summitplumbingut.com) is separate.

# Key facts
- Name: Summit Plumbing Pros (legal Summit Plumbing Pros LLC). Never "Summit Plumbing" alone (Utah brand). Scott later said not to include "LLC" in schema.
- Office: 950 W. Birchwood Ave, Ste 12, Mesa, AZ 85210. Residential only, AZ ROC #338366 (R-37R).
- Service area (10 cities): Mesa (home base), Gilbert, Chandler, Tempe, Queen Creek, San Tan Valley, Apache Junction, Fountain Hills, Scottsdale, Phoenix.
- Phone: website default (480) 447-7008, GBP shows (480) 470-8706. Both are GoHighLevel tracking lines; never "fix" the mismatch.
- Hours: Mon to Sat 8 AM to 5 PM, closed Sunday (Scott). No 24/7, after-hours or holiday claims.
- 15 approved services (General Plumbing, Drain Cleaning, Sewer Line Repair, Pipe Lining, Water Pressure, Water Leak Detection, Garbage Disposal, Fixture Installation, Tankless, Emergency Plumbing, Water Softeners, Water Filtration, Water Heaters, Slab Leak, Plumbing Maintenance). Signature service: trenchless pipe lining.
- Not offered: commercial, roof drains, repiping as a promoted service, gas lines, sump pumps, septic, home warranty plumbing; pipe bursting and epoxy lining unconfirmed.
- Reviews: about 517 to 525 Google reviews at 4.8 (Sep to Oct 2026).

# Brand, audience and positioning
- Customers: East Valley homeowners about 35 to 65, landlords and rental owners. Slab homes, hard water, aging cast iron and Orangeburg lines, monsoon backups.
- Voice: warm, neighborly, plain-spoken, 8th-grade reading level. Avoid hype, "guaranteed", "24/7", competitor and equipment brand names.
- Approved claims: licensed and insured, free estimates, upfront pricing (no numbers), "same-day service for most calls", locally operated, existing coupons ($20 off, $50 off water heater replacement, $25 referral).
- Map pack: weak for "plumber mesa az" (0 of 39 pins top 3), strong for "emergency plumbing services". AI visibility 1.8% vs Roto-Rooter 17.4%.
- Lead sources: GBP drives most booked leads; organic about 3 leads a month.

# SEO identity
- Priority keywords: "plumber mesa az" cluster (2,400 to 2,800 a month), emergency plumber [city], sewer line repair, drain cleaning mesa az, water heater repair [city], tankless installation.
- Cannibalization watch list: parent pages must not lead with Mesa; tankless vs water heater city pages; /drain-cleaning/ vs Mesa drain page; Tempe hub vs Tempe emergency page; blogs use informational keywords only.
- Content rules: Search Atlas research first (volume 100+, KD 0 to 30), keyword in H1, title, meta and body, direct answer first, FAQs, neutral .gov sources only, real job photos first.

# Decisions and status
- Open questions for Scott (10): years in business, profitable services, CIPP/bursting/epoxy, financing, warranties, certifications, holiday hours, ROC expiry, /home-warranty-plumbing/, emergency-search strategy.
